claims: Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor at the 2026 Oscars (98th Academy Awards) for his dual role in Sinners.
Timothée Chalamet was nominated for Best Actor at the 2026 Academy Awards for Marty Supreme.
Leonardo DiCaprio was nominated for Best Actor at the 2026 Academy Awards for One Battle After Another.
Ethan Hawke was nominated for Best Actor at the 2026 Academy Awards for Blue Moon.
Wagner Moura was nominated for Best Actor at the 2026 Academy Awards for The Secret Agent.
Michael B. Jordan portrayed Smoke and Stack in Sinners.
This marked Michael B. Jordan's first career Academy Award nomination and win.
Timothée Chalamet won at the Golden Globes.
Timothée Chalamet won at the Critics' Choice Awards.
Sinners led the night with 16 total nominations.
The 98th Academy Awards took place on March 15, 2026.
